ops.text: HDI warrants that (1) for ninety (90) days following the Company's acceptance, the Site and any software HDI delivers or makes available to the Company hereunder will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (2) for thirty (30) days following performance, the services performed by HDI under this Agreement will conform to the requirements of this Agreement. For breach of this warranty, HDI shall, at the Company's election, repair or replace the non-conforming Site, software or services, or refund the amounts paid by the Company for them.

input.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 carries only corporate-authority warranties, so HDI stands behind none of its development or hosting work. We have inserted our fallback performance warranty: 90 days documentation conformance for the Site and software, 30 days for the services, with repair/replacement or refund as the remedy.
input.summary: Insert HDI performance warranty (90-day software conformance, 30-day services) with repair/replace or refund remedy.
